runtime.hash_evidence: Expected digest from official GitHub release asset metadata; binary not downloaded by this preflight.
runtime.support_status: Official source contains qwen35 and mistral3 architecture dispatch and implementations. This verifies source-level support, not successful loading or inference of these specific GGUF payloads.
runtime.earliest_compatible_version: Not established; b11756 is a verified source-level compatibility baseline.

controls.request: chat_template_kwargs accepts enable_thinking; output parsing is separate from thinking mode. Reasoning format only controls extraction. Record prompt, output, and reasoning token counts separately.
controls.template_policy: Never reuse the Minerva template. Pin a model-specific template and its hash. The current original template can differ from the template embedded at quantization time; record which was used.
controls.comparison_policy: Use text only; no mmproj download is necessary. Keep context, slot count, sampling, seeds, input prompt bytes, budgets, and timeout explicit.

runtime.recommendation: Retain pinned b11756 for this comparison because it has source-level architecture support. Do not label these b releases stable; they are flagged prerelease.

stable_release_observed.conclusion: Latest non-prerelease has no Linux CPU binary asset. Do not treat its tag as a downloadable runtime.

requirements: Check actual MemAvailable, cgroup memory.max, CPU instruction support, free disk, and process limits before downloading.
Download and run one candidate at a time; avoid duplicated Hugging Face and manual download caches.
A weight file size is a lower bound, not an inference memory estimate. Runtime buffers, attention cache, recurrent state, OS memory, and context matter.
Record startup, prompt processing, generation, peak resident memory, and timeouts separately.
Avoid relying on swap or repeated mmap disk faults as evidence of acceptable classroom performance.
resource_gate.local_8_gib_fit: The 27B candidates and Ministral Q4_K_M are unsuitable. Qwen3.5-9B Q4_K_M has limited headroom and requires an observed memory gate; no claim of local fit or inference success is made.
resource_gate.runner_16_gb_fit: Qwen3.5-9B and Ministral Q4_K_M are plausible with bounded context and a single slot. Qwen3.8 UD-IQ4_XS is marginal and UD-Q4_K_M is impractical. Actual measured memory and available disk are required.
